modal.help_s1b: Sinthani Madrive a ma volume onse, + Onjezani foda kuwonjezera, x imachotsa imodzi, kapena matani njira zolekanitsidwa ndi `;` mu Edit. Kusintha matabu kumasintha mafoda.
modal.help_s2b: Dzina, Regex (Rust syntax), Fuzzy, Zamkatimu za fayilo, Glob (*.rs), Chilichonse (OR) / Palibe (NOT), makulidwe (ma byte kapena 10M/1G), madeti (YYYY-MM-DD), mndandanda wodumpha wa Exclude, Zowonjezera kapena group chips (sinthani, dinaninso kuchotsa; Manage imasintha anu), Nyanyazani case, Onetsani zobisika.
modal.help_s3b: Batani lalikulu la Scan & search kapena Enter. Refresh imayendetsanso ikusunga chosankhidwa. Live imayendetsa zokha zosintha (yozimitsa by default). Kusaka kopanda kanthu sikuthamanga — ikani * mu Glob pa zonse.
modal.help_s4b: Mitu ing'ono imasanja, Go imadumphira masamba, ma checkboxes amadyetsa Copy paths / Move / Delete ndi ma exports a CSV–TXT–HTML–Excel–RTF. Kusaka kosungidwa ndi Recent snapshots zimabwezera sefa zonse kuphatikizapo mafoda, OR/NOT, ndi zobisika.
modal.help_keys_body: Enter imasaka · Esc imachotsa focus / imatseka dialogs · ↑/↓ imasuntha chosankhidwa · Space imayika mzere · Tab imayenda pakati pa zowongolera.
